## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Normal, and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Both pick Normal |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal [F5] | All neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Unreliable [F2]
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical; not given as a reason · Weak [F3]
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 2, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Scored above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated [F4]
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; linked to invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Immune cell fraction** (regions 2, 7, 11) · context · Higher than 91% of reference images · Measured [F7]

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (0.002; −0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Cell sample is three regions with too few tumor nuclei; focal disease could be missed.
- Normal-lobule evidence failed its spot check; the call rests on classifier and neighbors.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 4:** Tumor-infiltrating stroma scored highest here; confirm no invasive foci.
2. **Regions 7, 11:** Highest per-region invasive risk (7%, 4%); look for atypia or necrosis.
3. **Region 9:** Duct-confined atypia score is low; confirm no in-situ change.
